2.title: Manifesto
slots: Most owners' videos go wrong before the camera is on, because three things were never decided: what you want to be known for, how your videos look, and what each video is about.

You know your work. Then you sit down to film, and every video starts from zero. One week it's a tip. The next it's something you saw another owner do. Each video is fine by itself, and together they tell a stranger nothing about what you do.
AI doesn't fix that. It will write you 24 scripts in a minute, and they are the 24 it would write for anyone in your field, because it only has what you type into it.

So we start with you. I interview you for 45 minutes about your work, your clients and how you got here. From that, we decide the three things with you, in writing, before a single script exists. Then we plan your 12 weeks like a season, which is why we call it Season One: every video has its job, and every script is written before you film it.

That is how a writers' room works. It is how a long series stays itself across dozens of scripts: the direction is settled first, every script is written against it, and every script is reviewed before it is filmed. We run your videos the same way, and I direct and review every script myself.
The scripts are in your words, from your stories. A line you would say to a client is easier to say than one you invent in front of a camera.
I stand behind every script. I don't promise followers, views or sales, because the filming and the posting are yours. Be careful with anyone who does promise them.

11.title: Questions
slots: What owners ask me before they start.
How much of my time does it take?

Your part is one 45-minute interview, with nothing to write beforehand. Then you read what I send and answer within 3 days. You film in sittings of 6 videos or fewer, about 4 sittings for 24 videos. We have one 20-minute setup call, and we talk twice more, for 15 minutes each, in week 4 and in week 8. Editing and posting stay with you or your editor.

You don't need to be good on camera. Each script comes with a shot list, so you know where to stand and what to show, and with a card of the points to say. A line you would say to a client is easier to say than one you invent in front of a camera, and these are your lines. Your one-page phone guide arrives on day 10, and you film where you already work.
Will this work for my kind of business?

If you sell a service or your expertise with your own face, yes. Your videos come from your story, whatever your field. It isn't for you if you have nothing to sell yet, or if you need someone to film, edit or post for you. If it doesn't fit, I say so on the call.
I've posted before and it didn't work.

Posting more will not fix it. Three things were never decided: what you want to be known for, how your videos look, and what each video is about. We decide them with you before a single script is written. And if you posted for two weeks and then stopped, nobody was keeping you on track. Here every delivery has a date, I write to you every Monday, and we talk in week 4 and in week 8. I don't promise followers, views or sales: I control the writing, and you control the filming and the posting.
You're new. How do I know it's any good?

You're right to ask, and I won't pretend otherwise. I won't show you results I don't have yet. So you see the work before you risk anything. On our call you get a one-page audit of your own videos, and you can judge whether it describes you. My own season is on this page. And your Brand Strategy arrives on day 7: if you're not happy with it, every dollar comes back and you keep the document.

You can. AI will write you 24 scripts in a minute. They are the 24 it would write for anyone in your field, because it only has what you type into it. The part it can't do for you is the part we do: a 45-minute interview with you, what you want to be known for decided with you, all 12 weeks planned together, and me keeping you on track. If scripts are all you need, AI is the cheaper choice and I'd tell you to use it.

Do we use AI ourselves? Of course. It would be strange not to in 2026. AI runs our internal systems, which is how we move fast and deliver on time. The creative work is different: it starts from your interview, and I direct and review every script myself. AI amplifies our creativity. It doesn't replace it.
What if I don't like a script?

Tell me what's off and I rewrite it. You approve every script before you film it. I write from your own words and examples, to be said out loud by you, so each script starts close to how you talk. How changes work is written on the one-page summary you get on our call.

You keep everything: your strategy, your look, your plan, every script and your AI, and they keep working without us. When your 12 weeks end, I stay available for 30 more days. Your client area, the community and the updates stay yours. If you want a second season, it is built on the strategy and the look you already own. It isn't on sale yet, and a founding client keeps the founding price for it when it starts within 30 days of the end of the first.
